mechanism: Rifampin is a potent inducer of CYP3A4 and other cytochrome P450 enzymes, which increases the metabolism of benztropine and reduces its plasma concentrations and anticholinergic efficacy.
action: Monitor for reduced anticholinergic effects (worsening extrapyramidal symptoms); consider increasing benztropine dose if needed, and reassess when rifampin therapy concludes.
